operatorContextBoundary.description: The OperatorContext is derived from the authenticated Identity session and forwarded server-to-server by DSH. Browser query, path, and header values cannot select the WLT OperatorContext.

invariants: Self-service representative finance uses the actor and OperatorContext resolved from the bearer session.
Control-panel representative finance uses the operator OperatorContext resolved from the bearer session.
DSH forwards X-Operator-Context-ID only from trusted Identity context.
WLT rejects representative wallet and ledger reads without X-Operator-Context-ID.
No frontend can override actorId, actorType, or operatorContextId for a self-service financial read.
WLT remains the sole owner of wallet balance and ledger truth.
negativeEvidence: cross-OperatorContext wallet hidden as not found
DSH and frontend balance mutation absent
